caption:
Maintenance duty is about as glamorous as they promised. Damp air, heavy lifting, and a lot of patience. Then the dock decided to get aggressive. Something in my bag just tried to fly across the room, nearly taking my arm with it. My grip is the only thing keeping me from being pinned to the wall. The facility’s hum just shifted into a low, rhythmic throb.

#NeoTokyo #ArchiveDeep #MaintenanceLog #IndustrialVibes #TechGlitch #HiddenCity
